description: This is a test class for the FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategy in the OrangeHRM Leave Plugin. It contains unit tests verifying the behavior of leave entitlement consumption logic, especially focusing on scenarios involving leave entitlements, application, and approval processes within HR management system.

classes.name: FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing FIFO entitlement consumption logic in leave management system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by creating an instance of FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategy and populating test data.

methods.name: testHandleLeaveStatusChangeNoEntitlements
methods.description: Tests leave creation handling when there are no valid leave entitlements available.

methods.name: testHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementBeforeApply
methods.description: Tests behavior when a single entitlement exists before leave application.

methods.name: testHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementBeforeAssign
methods.description: Tests behavior when a single entitlement exists before leave assignment.

methods.name: testHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementAfterApply
methods.description: Tests behavior after leave has been applied with an entitlement that starts after the leave date.

methods.name: testHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementAfterAssign
methods.description: Tests behavior after leave has been assigned with an entitlement that starts after the leave date.

methods.name: testHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementNotSufficientApply
methods.description: Tests behavior when available entitlement days are insufficient to cover the leave applied.

methods.name: xtestHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementNotSufficientAssign
methods.description: Test method for insufficient entitlement days on leave assignment (currently skipped or placeholder).

methods.name: xtestHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementExactAmount
methods.description: Test for exact entitlement amount matching leave days (currently skipped or placeholder).

methods.name: xtestHandleLeaveStatusChangeOneEntitlementExtra
methods.description: Test with extra entitlement days beyond leave days (currently skipped or placeholder).

methods.name: xtestGetLeaveWithoutEntitlementDateLimitsForLeaveBalance
methods.description: Test for retrieving date limits for leave balance in absence of specific entitlement dates (currently skipped).

methods.name: verifyEntitlements
methods.description: Helper method to verify current entitlement states and changes against expected results.
